props.name: variant

props.description: Draws a hairline under the header.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level. Pick the one that fits the page outline.

props.name: children
props.description: Placed at the top inline-end of the header, beside the title and description (e.g. a Badge, Link or menu button).

props.name: divider
props.description: Draws a hairline above the footer.

notes: A card is a plain div; CardTitle is a real heading (h3 by default).
If the whole card is a link, put the link on the title and extend its hit area with CSS rather than wrapping the card in <a>.
Give a card role="region" and aria-labelledby only when it is a major page landmark.

do: Keep one primary action per card, in the footer or CardAction.
Let parts that must bleed (tables, images) drop their inline padding.
dont: Don't nest cards; use a Separator or an outline card inside.
Don't put more than one heading level inside a CardHeader.
